chapter: Moving to California and the war years
title: Arriving in California cold and passing the hat
summary: He knew no one in California and survived passing the hat for 25 to 40 dollars a night.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: What did you think of California when you first got here?
I thought that I was going to make it out here if I got a chance.
What did you do the first couple of days? I just got here myself, you know. This is like I'm relating to this, because I just got here myself last week.
Well, I was -- you've got these gigs, you know, I was about just going around, passing the hat.
Yeah. And I'd be making 25, 30 and $40.00 a night, passing the hat for tips.
With them tips. And I kept them eating. I kept the group eating.
